title: Per-technique validation and tool charts on dashboard
description: Validation and tool charts only show the active member's data. When a new member starts, previous member's chart data is lost. The technique_events dict in live_status.json already stores per-technique data but the frontend ignores it. Add technique selector dropdown that switches validation/tool charts between techniques.
definition-of-done: 1. Technique selector dropdown added before validation chart. 2. Poll function populates selector from technique_events keys. 3. Switching techniques shows that technique's validation/tool timeline. 4. Active Member option shows current member data.
testing-plan: 1. Run a voyage batch through multiple techniques. 2. Technique selector shows all techniques. 3. Switching shows correct per-technique event data. 4. Active Member shows current data.
